instructions: Arrow keys move between piles and cards. Enter or Space picks up and drops cards, or turns over the stock. A sends a card to the foundations. Escape cancels.
stock: Stock, {count, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}}. Turn over cards
stockRecycle: Stock empty. Turn the waste back over
faceDown: Column {n}: face-down card. Turn it over
autoFinishLabel: Finish the game: move every card to the foundations
wonMessage: All cards are home! Score: {score}. Time: {seconds} seconds. Deal again?
